description: Reviewed initial working target for the selected level-5 Goblin Warrior, one-handed Shortsword and Heavy Breastplate reference: aim near 70% clear rate, with an inclusive 65-75% band for each fixed Blood Grove pairing. This policy applies only when explicitly selected for evaluation; other cohort policies and CI configuration are unchanged.

goals.rationale: Aim near 70% for this exact starter recipe in each selected encounter, rather than maximizing victories. The existing pointwise 95% Wilson interval must lie wholly inside 65-75% to pass; boundary overlap remains inconclusive. At least 100 trials permit diagnosis of large misses, but near-target confirmation needs a larger predeclared sample budget. These fixed pairs are not an area-wide spawn estimate or a requirement for every Essence.
goals.reviewReason: On 8 September 2026 the user approved approximately 70% clear rate for the selected Blood Grove starter and explicitly chose: Aim near 70% (use 65-75% as an initial working band). This approves the scoped working band, not a passing current build, unrelated pacing goals or a hosted CI gate.
